about: R3, wave 3: the stylized family held to the realistic body's body checks (plan 11.5, R3). `at_most`: no pair of the body's own sliders (build and proportions, at their ranges' ends) and none alone may make the body newly cross itself (measure.py --only ...,sliders,...: `body_bodies_with_new_crossings`, `body_alone_with_new_crossings`; the face's parameters are face_checks.py's). `at_least`: each joint keeps the ring area it had when this was set (2026-11-17), rounded down; the elbow and knee are far under the realistic body's 0.6 (no twist or helper bones), which needs a redesign of the stylized rig, so they are held, not raised. The proportion ranges are qa/ranges.py --package stylized's (docs/development/character-studio/refinement/r3/ranges.md, "Stylized shipped ranges").
